wholePhysicalScope: Rotorua Museum in January 2016. The January photographs show the completed former Bath House with its central west entry, Tudor Revival timber detailing, paired north and south transepts, roofs, lanterns and Centennial wings.
lodDetails: All four levels preserve the west gables, long wings and roof lanterns. Near views add braces, multipane windows, shaped finials and terracotta eave detail.
limitations: The named OpenStreetMap outline controls the exterior footprint. The January 2016 photographs document the west appearance after the 2008 and 2011 wing extensions.
Roof junctions behind the main facade, window spacing on the rear and end elevations, and architectural heights are estimated.
The independent elevation source is preserved. Foundations and stairs reflect an approximate local threshold.
The model represents the Bath House building and its attached wings. The rest of Government Gardens, collection interiors and post-2016 restoration work are outside the historical view.
